**问题与使用场景 / Problem and use case**
<!-- 先搜索已有 Issue，说明当前流程及遇到的问题。Search existing issues; describe your current workflow and problem. -->

**建议方案与预期结果 / Proposed change and expected outcome**
<!-- 描述可观察的成功标准。Describe observable acceptance criteria. -->


**涉及环境 / Affected environment**
- 系统与架构 / OS and architecture: Windows / macOS / Linux; x64 / ARM64
- Ua、AI 工具或编辑器版本 / Ua, AI tool or editor versions:
- 插件与模型（如适用）/ Plugin and model (if applicable):
- 技能入口（如适用）/ Skill route (if applicable): native `~/.agents/skills` / MCP
<!-- 技能由支持的客户端/插件发现和读取；部署数量不是模型调用证据。Supporting clients/plugins discover and read skills; deployed counts are not evidence of model invocation. -->

**已尝试的方案与补充材料 / Workarounds tried and context**
